_note: Caves and mines on the street map (world/innerMap/mines.js, ui/innerMapMining.js, ui/innerMapLayers/caves.js). Seconds are real seconds of work at the spot, divided by the Mining skill's blows perk and the pick carried (picks: best first). A cut rock leaves rubble that must be hauled out before the space is open; every unsupported run of dug cells risks a cave-in until it is shored up with timber.

adit._note: Cutting into a cliff face from its foot: stages of work before the drift is open and leads into the rock (the mine underground). Each stage gives stone.

shaft._note: Sinking a shaft in open ground: stages of digging, the last lining it with timber (one of `lining`) and hanging a ladder (one of `ladder`) before you can climb down.

support._note: A set of timbers (two posts and a cap) holds the roof for `reach` cells round it. A cut with more than `free` dug cells within `span` of it and no timbers over them may bring the roof down: base chance, more for each cell past free (a timber every four or five cells along a drift keeps it up).

map._note: The underground map: its size, how much of a natural cave is open passage, how many veins of ore run through the rock (per 100 rock cells), loose stones and crystal on a cave floor.

light._note: Underground it is dark at any hour: the radius (px at zoom 1) of the light the player carries, the best they have.

geology._note: What the rock of a hex's terrain holds: weights for the veins (stone is the rock itself, no vein). The hex's own resource (world tile .resource) is weighted up by resourceBoost.

veinChance._note: How richly the rock of a terrain is veined (multiplies map.veins).

crags._note: Worlds made since terrainGen 9 (world/innerMap/cliffs.js): bigger crags in tiers (a second step on a big one's top, a third on the second's), taller faces, and now and then a cave mouth in a face three rows tall (caves: the chance a square crag has one; maxCaves on a hex).

text.noPick: You need a pick to break rock: carry tools.
text.caveIn: The roof gives with a crack and a roar: rock comes down round you.
text.caveInHurt: Stone strikes you as it falls (-{hp} health).
text.unsupported: The roof creaks over the open ground behind you. Shore it up with timber.
text.packsFull: Your packs are full: the rubble stays where it lies.
text.enterCave: You duck under the rock into the cave. Only the light you carry shows the way.
text.enterMine: Into the mine. The dark closes in behind the light you carry.
text.enterShaft: You climb down the ladder into the dark.
text.leave: Back out into the open air.
